placements.title: Explicit Directives to Purge Specific Decisions and Migration Records
placements.frame: Which historical decisions and technical migrations are explicitly directed to be excised from active knowledge retention?
placements.why: Segments src-1 and src-2 issue unambiguous imperative commands to forget the Quantum Widget Decision and remove all knowledge of the PostgreSQL to QuantumDB migration, establishing a theme around active removal and forgetting directives.
